github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Follow these rules when generating git commit messages:

1. Message format: `type(scope): description`
- **type**: Choose from `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`, `perf`, `build`, `ci`, `style` based on what the diff actually does.
- **scope**: Infer in this priority order:
  1. Dominant directory/module in the diff (e.g. hooks, skills, etl).
  2. Component/ticket implied by branch name (e.g. branch `lsp-3559-optimize-agentic-ai-...` -> scope like `agents`).
  3. Reuse scope from the last two commits if this continues the same line of work.
  Omit scope only when no meaningful one exists.
- **description**: Lower-case, imperative sentence summarizing the change. No trailing period. Keep under ~72 chars.

2. Body: Add ONE short body paragraph after a blank line only when it explains *why* or links the change to recent work.

3. Relate to recent work: If continuing/fixing previous commits, reuse scope and phrase description as a continuation (e.g. 'extend', 'finish', 'follow up on'). Never fabricate relationships.
